test_title: PYST 4: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which letter-cluster pair DOES NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47fc55d1448a4e304a2615e2edcf078e2c0d6f8d74bc2a848a79ef83d6e78800.png] 

The logic followed here is:

**Option 1) RT-MO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1e94ee062df54c7c94ce949f57d7d9a684f12bf3ef1b40b1225566327595b164.png] 

Option 2) OQ-JM

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44194ac498e12f447dee85f28cf92ce60b269df7d5d65938b2e87d8bc7b61274.png] 

Option 3) WY-RU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d519c89493fef3c188d35a0e5f2f9416c544c2bd9bed19e9752d1d5dcdd9d7c2.png] 

Option 4) UW-PS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/577b57abb9b569d845fee93829079d3343cbc6daa4c49951584f65d4110657f1.png] 

Here, 'RT-MO' is odd among the given options.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
